meta.title: SinoBee.ai — the open-source AI swarm that works on your computer
meta.description: SinoBee official website: try the agent online, download & install, Skill Hub, commissioned AI tasks, public model and skill evaluations.

footer.tagline: SinoBee is an open-source swarm-intelligence assistant that works on your computer: it researches, reads and writes files, drives a browser and desktop, and hands back tables, charts and files.

home.badge: Open source · MIT · mix cloud and local models
home.lead: SinoBee searches the web, reads files, writes code, runs commands and operates the browser, mouse and keyboard; it also runs scheduled background work and produces complete videos. It delivers tables, charts, files and films. Risky actions ask you first, you can add instructions or stop it mid-task, and it remembers your preferences and gets better over time.
home.shotAlt: SinoBee explaining a GitHub project with a table and a flow chart
home.featuresTitle: One assistant that finishes the job
home.featuresLead: More than chat: SinoBee has tools, layered memory, skills and fixed workflows — and brakes.

research.title: Research
research.body: Reads web pages, news, documents and GitHub projects, cross-checks sources and cites them.

data.title: Data analysis
data.body: Analyzes CSV, Excel, logs and database exports and produces charts and reports.

files.title: File management
files.body: Sorts, renames, converts and batch-processes files — never overwriting a file with the same name.

video.title: AI video production
video.body: One sentence becomes a short film, documentary or ad: script, characters, locations, shot list, voice, rendering, editing and subtitles are automatic, with a draft to approve before the final render. A production kit is exported too, so a sequel keeps the same characters and look.

work.title: Background work & schedules
work.body: Sub-agents working in parallel, fixed workflows (YAML graphs), a shared blackboard and schedules; the Work tab shows past, present and next, and interrupted work can resume.

steer.title: Steer while it works
steer.body: Add instructions or stop a task mid-run; intermediate files appear as links; each stretch of work folds into one summary line. Before finishing it checks the job is really done, and switches to a stronger model when a weak one gets stuck.

browser.title: Browser & desktop
browser.body: A real Chromium with saved logins; Docker mode adds a virtual desktop you can watch and take over.

approval.title: Asks before risky actions
approval.body: Deleting files, installing software, admin rights or force-pushing need your approval; keys and passwords stay on your machine and never reach the model. Modes: confirm, auto, readonly.

memory.title: Layered memory
memory.body: Task, short-term, long-term and permanent memory, tidied, compressed and expired automatically; key facts are saved before a long conversation is summarised. Ratings and your instructions update it, and you can view, pin or delete memories any time.

skills.title: Skills
skills.body: Reusable workflows following the Agent Skills standard. Create with /learn; install from the Hub, GitHub or a folder, with trust levels. Matching skills are suggested automatically, and complex skills can declare fixed workflows.

models.title: Any model
models.body: Mix OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini and other cloud models with local Ollama models: pick the main, auxiliary, escalation and fallback models separately. Paste a key, press “Connect”, and its models are verified and listed at once.

usage.title: Usage & budgets
usage.body: Every call logs tokens and cost; set daily and monthly budgets with an alert at 80%.

home.casesTitle: What it can do for you

0.title: Research: explain a GitHub project

download.title: Download & install SinoBee
download.lead: Docker is the one-line recommended setup; you can also install it natively to control your own desktop.

docker.title: Docker
docker.body: Windows, macOS or Linux — just Docker Desktop or Docker Engine.

python.title: Python 3.10+
python.body: For the native install; on macOS and Windows SinoBee can control the real desktop.

local.title: Local models (optional)
local.body: On Apple Silicon install Ollama natively; with an NVIDIA GPU use the bundled Ollama container.

download.dockerLead: Install Docker first, then clone and start SinoBee with one command:
download.dockerOpen: Open http://localhost:10024 — setup opens automatically the first time.
download.cloudBody: Under Settings → Model providers, paste an API key and press “Connect”: SinoBee verifies it and loads that provider's models, then pick the main, auxiliary, escalation and fallback models above. Keys stay in secrets.json on the server, only the last four characters are shown, and nothing is written to .env.
download.startWithKeysTitle: Pass the model and key at start-up
download.localLead: No API bills and your data stays home: run open models locally, free and keyless.
download.localMac: On a Mac install and open Ollama first (uses the Metal GPU), then start SinoBee — it connects to host.docker.internal:11434 automatically:
download.localGpu: With an NVIDIA GPU add the GPU compose file:
download.pipLead: Requires Python 3.10 or later. Run the install script once, then use the sinobee command from any folder:
download.pipMacNote: On macOS grant the terminal Accessibility and Screen Recording in System Settings → Privacy & Security. On a physical machine keep the approval mode on confirm.

firstRun.0: Open Settings → Models: paste any provider's key under Model providers and press “Connect”, or open Ollama (local) to download a model; then choose the main model. Cloud and local models can be mixed.
firstRun.1: Describe the result in plain words — the more specific the better, e.g. “make it a table”, “save as report.md”, “make a 30-second product ad”.
firstRun.2: Risky actions show an approval card: allow, deny, or switch to read-only. While a task runs you can type extra instructions or press stop.
firstRun.3: Leave long or recurring work to the Work tab: fixed workflows, sub-agents and schedules live there, with progress and output files at a glance.
firstRun.4: Rate results with thumbs up/down; SinoBee updates its memory and skills. Memory is tidied automatically, and the Memory tab lets you view, pin or delete entries.

download.cliHub: SinoBee ships with a Skill Hub client. To trust this Hub’s review signatures, pin its public key in your config:

0.a: The result card explains the cause and a fix; expand “Technical details” for the raw message. Usually an invalid key, a wrong model name or exhausted quota.

1.a: Install and open Ollama, or run docker compose --profile local-llm up -d, then click “Re-detect”.

2.a: Pick a smaller model labelled “GPU-accelerated”; on a Mac install Ollama natively instead of in a container.

3.q: Local model can’t operate the computer

4.a: git pull && docker compose up -d --build, then hard-refresh the browser; your data lives in Docker volumes and is kept.

5.q: Added a Gemini (or other) key but no models to pick
5.a: Press “Connect” on the provider card: the key is verified at once and its models appear in the list above; “invalid key” means the key needs to be regenerated. On the latest version cloud models can be selected even while the main model is a local one.

6.a: The default port is now 10024: open http://localhost:10024. A server.port in your config.yaml takes precedence.

download.tryOnlineNote: Want a look before installing? Try the SinoBee agent at agent.sinobee.ai.

auth.title: Sign in with CAFECA
auth.lead: Use the Passkey in your CAFECA wallet — no password. Signing in opens a signing channel; every later payment or signature is confirmed by you in CAFECA.
auth.statement: Sign in to SinoBee.ai to manage skills, commissions and evaluations
auth.redirect: Sign in with a full-page redirect
auth.qr: Scan a QR code with your phone
auth.qrHint: Scan with a phone signed in to CAFECA; this page signs in after you confirm on the phone.
auth.errDenied: You declined the sign-in in CAFECA.
auth.errPopup: The browser blocked the popup. Allow popups or use the redirect option.
auth.privacy: SinoBee.ai only receives your CAFECA identity address, handle and verification level; real-name data is never requested by default.

skills.lead: Submit, download, rate and discuss SinoBee skills. Every skill follows the Agent Skills standard and works with other compatible agents.
skills.cliBody: SinoBee has a built-in Hub client: search, install, update and publish skills, with content hash, signature and revocation checks.

skill.noEvaluations: No evaluation reports for this skill yet.
skill.useInTask: Commission a task with this skill
skill.anchorHelp: The bundle and SKILL.md hashes are notarized on Boltchain; open to verify independently

submit.title: Submit a skill
submit.lead: Upload a SKILL.md or the .tar.gz produced by sinobee skills export. Published versions are immutable — publish a new version or revoke.
submit.publisherHelp: Your publisher id appears in install commands (hub:<publisher>/<skill>) and cannot change after you publish.
submit.submitted: Submitted for review (downloadable at the “community” trust level until reviewed)
submit.rejected: The automatic security scan marked it dangerous — not listed
submit.formatBody: Frontmatter allows only name, description, license, compatibility, allowed-tools and metadata; name must equal the folder name, and the Hub requires metadata.version (quoted semver).
submit.cliBody: Create a Hub token in your account, then:

review.0: Automatic checks: Agent Skills spec validation, content hash, security scan (prompt injection, credentials, invisible characters, dangerous scripts).
review.1: Versions the scan marks dangerous are not listed; others are downloadable at the “community” trust level.
review.2: After human review the Hub signs the content hash with ed25519 and marks it reviewed.
review.3: Verified publisher + reviewed + valid signature → SinoBee installs it as “verified”.

admin.title: Skill Hub review
admin.noKey: HUB_SIGNING_KEY is not set, so approved versions cannot be signed. Run npm run hub:keygen.
admin.confirmRevoke: Revoking adds the content hash to the revocation list; SinoBee clients block it after syncing. Continue?

st.low: The wallet is running low: new objects stay in the mirror until BOLT is topped up.

admin.confirmTakedown: The share page stops working at once and its content key is destroyed. Continue?

hubApi.lead: The sinobee.ai Skill Hub protocol v1, compatible with the SinoBee client (sinobee skills search / install / publish / sync-revocations).

trust.0: Download the bundle (≤ 20 MB, ≤ 500 files; path traversal, symlinks and device files are rejected).
trust.1: Validate against the Agent Skills spec; compute the content hash and compare with the Hub’s sha256 — abort on mismatch.
trust.2: Verify the signature (ed25519 over the content_hash string) with the pinned public keys.
trust.3: Abort if the Hub scan says dangerous; run a local security scan as well.
trust.4: Verified publisher, reviewed version and valid signature → verified; otherwise community.

tasks.title: Commissions
tasks.lead: Fund a task and SinoBee completes it in the cloud. Public commissions appear here; anyone can rate and discuss the results.
tasks.emptyMine: You have not commissioned anything yet.
tasks.newLead: The platform runs SinoBee in a Docker container dedicated to you. You pay 1.5× the actual model token, AWS VM rental and AWS S3 costs. If the budget runs out before the task is done, the current results are packaged and CAFECA asks you to add funds or close the task.

steps.0: Describe the task, pick a model and a budget
steps.1: Pay the budget in TWDC with CAFECA
steps.2: Runs in your own Docker container
steps.3: Notified via CAFECA — download within 7 days

taskForm.title: Title
taskForm.titlePh: e.g. Taiwan EV market report for Q3 2026
taskForm.evalTitlePh: e.g. web-research skill accuracy on Chinese news fact-checking
taskForm.promptPh: Describe the result and the deliverable in plain words, e.g. “summarize as a table and save as report.xlsx”.
taskForm.promptHint: Be specific: sources, deliverable format, success criteria. Nobody can answer questions during the run; SinoBee states its assumptions in SUMMARY.md.
taskForm.evalPrompt: What to evaluate, in which scenario
taskForm.evalPromptPh: Which capability, in what situation? e.g. verify 10 Chinese news stories and cite the original sources.
taskForm.criteriaPh:
One case or criterion per line, e.g.
1. Finds the original source (30 pts)
2. Correct verdict (50 pts)
3. Complete citations (20 pts)
taskForm.publicHint: Anyone can see the description, summary, ratings and comments (only you can download the result files).
taskForm.evalPublic: Evaluation reports are always public: time, requester, skill, model, method, process and result.
taskForm.estNote: Raw cost × {markup} at 1 USD = {rate} TWDC. You pay actual usage, never more than your budget.
taskForm.budgetHint: Minimum {min} TWDC. When the budget runs out the task pauses and asks you to add funds; results are kept {days} days after completion (longer for subscribers).

pay.relayHint: Sent to your CAFECA — confirm on your phone (or scan the QR code).
pay.noChannel: This session has no signing channel, so it cannot pay. Sign in again and allow the signing channel.
pay.rejected: You declined the payment in CAFECA.

task.needsFundingTitle: Budget used up — the task is not finished
task.needsFundingBody: The current results are packaged (download on the right). Add funds to continue where it stopped, or close the task and keep the results. Without an answer it closes automatically after {days} days.
task.rateNote: TWDC, raw cost × 1.5 at 1 USD = {rate} TWDC (locked when the commission was created).
task.noResults: Downloads appear here when the run finishes.
task.expired: The download window has ended and the file was deleted.
task.retentionNote: For non-subscribers, containers and results are kept only {days} days after a task finishes — download early.
task.publicNote: This commission is public. Only the requester can download the result files.
task.confirmClose: The task will not continue; current results stay downloadable. Close it?

bench.title: Model & skill benchmarks
bench.lead: Every evaluation is run by SinoBee and published in full: time, requester, skill, model, method, process and result. Anyone can commission an AI evaluation.
bench.modelsNote: Scores average the reports evaluating models without a skill (0–100). {n} models are available for commissions.
bench.empty: No evaluation reports yet — be the first to commission one.

0.title: Commission
0.body: Choose the model (and skill), the method and criteria, and fund it.

1.title: Run
1.body: SinoBee runs the evaluation in an isolated container and records every step.

2.title: Publish
2.body: The report is public here and on the skill page for anyone to read and discuss.

bench.newLead: An evaluation is a commission too: 1.5× the actual token, VM and S3 cost. The report is published on the benchmarks and skill pages.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.lead: Commissions are billed on actual usage — no monthly fee, no minimum. A subscription extends how long containers and results are kept.
pricing.formulaNote: Paid in TWDC (CAFECA’s TWD stablecoin). USD costs convert at 1 USD = {rate} TWDC, locked when a commission is created.
pricing.tokensBody: SinoBee records tokens and cost for every model call (vendor list prices, cache discounts included).
pricing.vmBody: Per second while running: ${price}/hour ({cpus} vCPU / {mem} GB RAM per task).
pricing.s3Body: Result storage: ${gb} per GB-month, prorated by retention; ${put} per 1,000 writes and ${get} per 1,000 reads.
pricing.modelNote: List prices are vendor reference values; billing uses SinoBee’s recorded cost (with cache discounts) × 1.5.
pricing.freeA: Your own Docker container, kept {days} days after a task finishes.
pricing.freeB: Results downloadable for {days} days after completion, then deleted for good.
pricing.freeC: Pay for actual usage; the run pauses and asks you before exceeding the budget.
pricing.subA: Your container is kept while subscribed (memory, skills and browser logins persist).

budget.0: You set a budget and pay with CAFECA when you submit; cost is metered every 15 seconds and the charge never exceeds the budget.
budget.1: If the budget runs out first, the platform packages the current results and CAFECA asks you to add funds or close the task.
budget.2: After a top-up the run continues where it stopped, in the same container and session.
budget.3: Without a top-up or close within the download window, the task closes automatically.

account.title: Account
account.channelClosed: Not open — sign in again before paying
account.publisherHelp: 2–39 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens, e.g. cafeca. Cannot change after you publish.
account.subNone: Not subscribed: containers and results are kept only {days} days after a task finishes.
account.tokensHelp: For sinobee skills publish (sinobee keys set sinobee-hub).
account.tokenOnce: This token is shown only once:
account.devicesHelp: Devices signed in with sinobee login. Signing one out revokes its token immediately.
account.noDevices: No devices yet. Run sinobee login in SinoBee.
account.myToolsHelp: Tools registered from SinoBee's Database tab. Private tools are visible only to you; public ones are listed after review.
account.noTools: No tools yet. Open a database connection in SinoBee and press “Register on SinoBee.ai”.
account.vaultHelp: Private tools' connection settings and passwords are encrypted on your machine with your vault passphrase before upload; the server keeps only ciphertext (on Boltchain) and cannot open it.
account.vaultNone: Not set up. It is created when you register a private tool in SinoBee with “Sync connection details (encrypted)”.
account.mySharesHelp: Conversations shared from SinoBee. Open a share to change who can see it or revoke it; revoking destroys its content key at once.
account.noShares: No shares yet. Use the share button in a SinoBee conversation.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.lead: Task completions, budget requests, skill reviews and comments — also pushed through CAFECA.

device.title: Sign in to SinoBee
device.lead: After running sinobee login (or pressing “Sign in to SinoBee.ai” in Settings), check that the code below matches the one SinoBee shows, then approve.
device.enterCode: Enter the code shown by SinoBee
device.notFound: That code was not found or has expired (15 minutes). Sign in again from SinoBee.
device.checkCode: Make sure this matches the code in SinoBee

scope.skills_publish: Publish skills to the Skill Hub
scope.tools_write: Register and update your tools (e.g. database browsers)
scope.vault_rw: Read and write your encrypted vault (the server cannot see its contents)

device.approvedHelp: Go back to SinoBee — sign-in completes within a few seconds. You can close this page.
device.warn: If you did not just start this sign-in from SinoBee, press Deny.

tools.title: Tools
tools.lead: Database browsers and other tools registered from SinoBee. A tool describes what to connect to and how — user names and passwords are never uploaded; private tools keep their connection details in your end-to-end encrypted vault.
tools.installHelp: After installing, enter your own credentials in SinoBee's Database tab (read-only by default).
tools.inVault: In your encrypted vault (unreadable by the server)
tools.ownCredentials: Entered by each user, never uploaded
tools.anchored: The TOOL.json hash is notarized on Boltchain, certificate
tools.confirmDelete: Delete this tool and all its versions? Copies on Boltchain have their keys destroyed and storage cancelled.
tools.publicHelp: Public tools are reviewed first and cannot reference a private vault.
tools.privateHelp: Once private, other people can no longer see this tool.

share.needLogin: Sign in with CAFECA to view this share.
share.notAllowed: This share is limited to specific CAFECA accounts, and yours is not one of them.

visHelp.LINK: Anyone who has the link can view it; it is not listed or indexed.
visHelp.LOGIN: Viewers sign in with CAFECA; you can limit it to specific accounts.
visHelp.PUBLIC: Anyone can view it, and it is listed on sinobee.ai/shares.

share.anchored: Content hashes are notarized on Boltchain, certificate
share.accounts: CAFECA accounts that may view (one per line, 0x address or @handle)
share.accountsHelp: Leave empty to allow any signed-in user.
share.confirmRevoke: The link stops working at once; the content key is destroyed and copies on Boltchain can no longer be opened. Continue?
share.reported: Thanks — we will look into it.
share.listLead: Conversations people shared publicly from SinoBee.
share.continueHelp: Import this conversation into your SinoBee as a new chat and keep going. SinoBee must be running on this computer.
